#   Generated by scripts/ecliptic-vectors.c in this repository, which
#   calls the unmodified library (iauObl80, iauObl06, iauEcm06). This
#   file and that program are not SOFA software and are not
#   endorsed by, SOFA.
#
#   The atlas takes no dependency on SOFA at run time or at build
#   time: these are numbers an authority produced, checked in so the
#   fixed mean-ecliptic-of-J2000 model can be held to them, and
#   nothing here is fetched, compiled, or called by the application.
#
# Columns
#   obliquity_j2000_deg : IAU 1980 mean obliquity at J2000.0
#   ecl <lambda> <beta> <ra_j2000> <dec_j2000> : the ICRS/J2000
#     equatorial direction of an ecliptic-frame direction, via the
#     J2000 ecliptic matrix (iauEcm06), degrees.
#   eclpole <ra_j2000> <dec_j2000> : the J2000 ecliptic north pole.
#   utc_as_tt_worst_arcsec : what passing these UTC dates to
#     SOFA's TT-based routines costs, at the worst of the dates
#     and axes below. The dates are UTC; no TT conversion is
#     applied, and this is the price of that.
#   ofdate <iso> <eps_of_date> <pole_ra> <pole_dec> <equinox_ra>
#     <equinox_dec> : the rival candidate - the MEAN ecliptic and
#     equinox OF DATE - expressed in the same ICRS/J2000 frame.
#     Mean, not true: no nutation is applied, to either candidate.
#
